Subject: Aurora Health — Decision roadmap & next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Janelle / Michael — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed decision roadmap so everyone has the same view. Please confirm edits / owners.

Key pain points you shared:
- Production latency spikes during morning batch processing windows (P95 spikes to ~450ms).
- Token cost on current provider is unpredictable at scale; target is ~40% unit cost reduction.
- Need for private deployment (VPC/managed on-prem) for PHI-sensitive workloads and tighter audit controls.
- Desire to support multitenant inference across three internal apps with per-team observability.

Primary goals we heard:
1) Sub-100ms P95 for 512-token average inference by Q3 pilot.
2) Baseline unit-cost reduction of 30–45% depending on model/quantization choices.
3) Private deployment with KMS integration and 90-day audit logs.

Mutual action plan (draft) — milestones, owners, and target dates:
- M1: Technical deep-dive + perf sandbox (Redwood + Aurora engineering) — Owner: Rishi / Aurora Eng — target: 2027-03-31
- M2: Security & compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence, KMS options) — Owner: Marissa / Aurora SecOps — target: 2027-04-07
- M3: Procurement & commercial review (pricing, SOW, contract) — Owner: Sean / Aurora Procurement — target: 2027-04-18
- M4: Pilot kickoff (private deployment, smoke tests) — Owner: Rishi / Aurora SRE — target: 2027-05-02
- M5: Pilot review + go/no-go for widening rollout — Owner: Joint execs — target: 2027-06-01

Attachments in this email: aurora-map-v1.xlsx (milestone grid) and redwood-pricing-3tier.pdf (pricing scenarios).

Open questions I flagged on the call:
- Which Aurora app will take the pilot traffic (clinical notes ingestion vs patient messaging)?
- Is there a preference for managed VPC vs on-prem appliance for the pilot environment?
- Who is the procurement point-of-contact for contract redlines?

Proposed immediate next steps (pick one):
- Confirm stakeholders and the pilot app by Monday 3/22
- Book the technical deep-dive (60–90m) for week of 3/29 — I can propose slots once you confirm busy windows

Thanks — I’ll incorporate any edits and resend an updated timeline.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
